privileged-scan-unavailable.notes: Deterministic eligibility: Resolve-UiaPrivilegedScanEligibility OBSERVES service installation, authorized-group membership of the launching user, configure-baked signer pins, and elevation (read-only probes; pins are never provisioned or modified), and always appends the campaign-policy absences clean-host-requirement and host-contamination. Skip detail carries the machine-readable expected form SKIP/reason=PRIVILEGED_SCAN_CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE/evidence=<facts>; if every code is false the scenario must FAIL loudly instead of skipping.

engine-connect-unavailable.notes: Engine handshake was not observed in the session; the scenario needs engine-served snapshot data to assert anything real.

connected-state-observed.notes: Degraded-badge observation requires an engine-disconnected session state; a connected state makes the degraded text unobservable by definition.

engine-connected-host.notes: The early engine-less check requires an engine-less observation window; an engine-connected host makes that precondition unobservable.

explorer-drag-source-unavailable.notes: PR #14 closure (2026-10-22): the historical 'synthetic input cannot arm the host Explorer OLE drag source' mechanism is DISPROVEN — probe2 delivered Explorer->Explorer with the exact harness drag primitive. The observed blocked boundary is drop DELIVERY into the FastFiles window from an external (Explorer) source: source selection and input arming succeed 100%, the FastFiles drop handler never executes, and the failing pair (external source -> FastFiles window) is not further separable on this host. Reason code retained for contract stability; see evidence/uia-explorer-drag-in-investigation.md.

interactive-drop-target-obstructed.notes: A third-party shell paste interceptor owns the bound drop point; the harness must not kill or neutralize host shell extensions.

interactive-window-layout-unavailable.notes: After Phase 4 P3 left-half normalization the only remaining layout skip is a genuinely too-small display for two non-overlapping windows.

interactive-foreground-unavailable.notes: Foreign-foreground races vary run-to-run on this interactive host (same-host PASS history for drag-between-panes and selection-model-interactions); Phase 4 P1 requires proven foreign ownership before this skip may be recorded.

ui-exe-not-built.notes: The UI binary was not built before execution; harness/setup issue, never product behavior.
